g1-implement.title: G1 measure-before-fixing: wetness coverage + the pre-change baseline
g1-implement.imperative: Fill templates/IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF.template.md and dispatch constellation-implementer via scripts/run_crew.py (--dispatch external + --verify-result in this harness). TASK: ship a read-only measurement script and its findings doc that establish, on the real season DBs, the four numbers every later gate's constants and claims depend on. (a) session_surface_features.wet_lap_fraction population by (year, session_type) -- the planning run measured 22/22 for R and 0/22 for Q in BOTH 2022 and 2023; reproduce or refute it on the current base. (b) Every rain-flagged session bucketed by its compound-proxy wet-lap fraction (share of laps on INTERMEDIATE/WET), so the ramp's two constants are chosen against a real histogram rather than a guess -- the planning run found ~5 of ~35 flagged sessions under 20% wet. (c) Session-retention under three rules: any-session-wet WEEKEND rule, per-session binary flag, per-session graded -- the planning run measured 59% / 84% / 85-86%, i.e. granularity is worth ~25 points and thresholding ~1-2. (d) The PRE-CHANGE band distribution (median, p90, vacuous count, plausible-|D| count) over the stored grip records, which is the baseline g4's delta is measured against. NO production code changes in this gate. The findings doc must state its frame explicitly: 2022-2023 only, because that is the only surface-features coverage that exists (2018 0/105, 2021 22/110, 2024 24/120) -- and must NOT generalize past it. Wait for and integrate the returned IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.

g2-implement.title: G2 the graded-wetness resolver: one home, two adapters
g2-implement.imperative: Fill the implementer handoff and dispatch. TASK: create src/physics/layer2/session_wetness.py -- the single home for 'how wet was this session', returning a CONTINUOUS severity plus its provenance, for ANY session type. Contract: resolve_session_wetness(db_path, session_id) -> SessionWetness(severity: Optional[float], source: str). PRIMARY branch: session_surface_features.wet_lap_fraction when populated. FALLBACK branch: the physics-local compound proxy -- this session's fraction of laps on INTERMEDIATE/WET -- which exists because #575's populator is R-only and the column is therefore NULL for every FP/Q/S/SQ session today (measured 0/22 for Q in 2022 and 2023). UNKNOWN: severity=None with source='unknown' -- NEVER 0.0, because 0.0 means 'measured dry' and None means 'not populated'; #680 established this exact discipline and it must not be softened. source is one of 'surface_features' | 'compound_proxy' | 'unknown'. THEN make damage_batch.is_wet_race DELEGATE to this resolver, preserving its bool return and threshold=0.1 default EXACTLY -- it is today's second implementation of this same read, which is what makes this a real seam rather than a speculative one. Write the resolver so the proxy branch stops firing on its own when #728's backfill lands: the primary branch simply starts winning and wetness_source records the switch, with no physics change. Wait for and integrate the IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.
